annotations.title: Quote, book or cancel a courier

description: Gets a quote for, books, checks the status of, or cancels a point-to-point courier delivery in Calgary. A booking is real and a driver is assigned when available; payment is a link sent to the customer by text and this call never charges a card. A booking can be cancelled while it is pending or assigned.

customer_phone.description: Required for action 'book', 'status', and 'cancel' — for 'status'/'cancel' this must match the phone on the booking (it's the ownership check, since booking_ref alone is guessable)

idempotency_key.description: Optional, action 'book' only — pass the same value on a retry (e.g. after a dropped connection) to avoid creating a duplicate booking

preferred_dropoff_time.description: Any parseable date/time the customer needs the delivery completed by, e.g. 'today 10pm'; must not be before preferred_pickup_time

preferred_pickup_time.description: Any parseable date/time; omit for ASAP dispatch

name: book_courier
